# Roadmap (generated by `tools/milestone.py roadmap` — do not edit)

| ID | Status | Milestone | Depends | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R0 | VERIFIED | Host toolchain ready | - | scripts/doctor.sh reports every required tool with real versions and missing=0. Negative: run with an empty PATH, missing>0. |
| R1 | VERIFIED | Firmware imported and hash-locked | R0 | Importer copies the user's stock archive contents into firmware/extracted using real tools, prints real sha256 of archive and key images (boot, system, vendor, vbmeta, dtbo) and compares them to config/firmware.lock.json. Negative: tampered copy compares unequal. |
| R2 | VERIFIED | Stock kernel Image and DTB extracted with real tools | R1 | From the real boot.img: kernel Image and DTB(s) extracted with real tools into build/stock/. Evidence prints the stock kernel version string and the decompiled DTB compatible. Negative: same commands on an empty file yield neither. |
| R3 | VERIFIED | QEMU machine `cepheus` skeleton | R2 | Custom QEMU (pinned, overlay applied, built by scripts) starts machine `cepheus` paused (-S) with 8 CPUs and the SM8150 memory map taken from the stock DTB; monitor `info cpus` and `info mtree` show it. Negative: stock-style `-machine virt` run lacks the SM8150 regions. |
| R4 | VERIFIED | Stock kernel boots with native GENI UART | R3 | Stock Image + stock DTB boot on `cepheus`; kernel messages appear on the NATIVE GENI UART model via earlycon. Negative: UART model disabled -> no kernel output. |
| R5 | VERIFIED | GICv3, arch timer, PSCI, 8-CPU SMP | R4 | Kernel brings up 8 CPUs with native GICv3, arch timer and PSCI. Negative: boot with maxcpus=1 on the cmdline. |
| R6 | VERIFIED | Native clock/reset, TLMM pinctrl, SPMI/PMIC models | R5 | Native models for exactly what the stock kernel requests; each stock driver probe that previously deferred/failed now succeeds, shown by real kernel/debugfs output captured by a command-only probe. Failing probes are listed and classified (allowlisted vs missing model). |
| R7 | VERIFIED | Native UFS host controller (+SMMU as needed) | R6 | Stock kernel ufshcd-qcom probes the native UFS HC and enumerates LUNs as SCSI disks. Negative: UFS model removed -> no SCSI disk lines. |
| R8 | VERIFIED | Real GPT/LUNs from real images | R7 | LUN images built from the real stock images; the stock kernel parses the real GPT and exposes real partitions (/proc/partitions printed raw by a command-only probe). Negative: corrupted GPT -> no partitions. |
| R9 | VERIFIED | Real Android init (first and second stage) | R8 | Stock ramdisk -> real Android init prints its own first/second stage logs on the kernel log. Negative: ramdisk removed. |
| R10 | IN-PROGRESS | Dynamic partitions mounted by real init (DRAFT) | R9 | Real init mounts system/vendor/product from the real super (dm-linear) with the ROM's fstab. |
| R11 | NOT-STARTED | SELinux enforcing with the ROM policy (DRAFT) | R10 | ROM policy loaded by real init, enforcing, no global permissive, denials visible. |
| R12 | NOT-STARTED | Real property service, binder and service managers (DRAFT) | R11 | Real servicemanager/hwservicemanager/vndservicemanager running over real binder; service list printed raw by the real tool. |

| R14 | NOT-STARTED | sys.boot_completed from the real init (DRAFT) | R13 | Property set by the real boot flow, read by real getprop; never set by hand. |
| R15 | NOT-STARTED | Stock adbd over virtual transport (DRAFT) | R14 | Real adb to the guest; real pm list packages / getprop output from the real guest. |

| D1 | NOT-STARTED | Native display controller probes on the stock kernel (DRAFT) | R7 | The display driver selected by the stock DTB probes against a NATIVE display-controller model and the guest exposes a real DRM/fb device (kernel log + /sys/class). | M1 | NOT-STARTED | Root via Magisk-patched boot image (DRAFT) | F1, R15 | User-supplied Magisk (firmware/input, no downloads) patches boot.img; real `adb shell su -c id` prints uid=0 and real getprop reports the boot-chain state truthfully (not green/locked). | A1 | NOT-STARTED | User apps and games run (DRAFT) | R16, N1, D3 | User-supplied APKs installed with real `adb install`; real `pm path` and `am start`; real dumpsys shows the resumed activity; screencheck frame-diff shows the app drawing. Negative: `pm uninstall` -> `pm path` empty. |
